note: Distances the books state. A league is 3 miles: the Wall is 'three hundred miles' (AGOT, Jon) and 'a hundred leagues' (ACOK, Jon; World of Ice & Fire). `how`: straight = as the crow flies, road = along a road, any = overland, mode unstated. Checked by tools/books/travel-check.mjs.

distances.quote: One hundred leagues from Deepwood Motte to Winterfell.
It was a hundred leagues from Astapor to Yunkai by the old Ghiscari coast road, and another fifty from Yunkai to Meereen.
and another fifty from Yunkai to Meereen.
Two hundred leagues divided Meereen from Astapor
Between Meereen and Volantis lay five hundred leagues of deserts, mountains, swamps, and ruins, plus Mantarys with its sinister repute.
Only three leagues of coast road divided Sunspear from the Water Gardens
The Tarly lands lay inland amidst thickly wooded foothills, a hundred leagues northeast of Oldtown
Mole's Town, the little village half a league south along the kingsroad
Only sixty leagues away, Tumbleton had been sacked in the most savage fashion
distances.cite: World of Ice & Fire, the Dance of the Dragons (after King's Landing fell to Rhaenyra)

distances.quote: The Watch had once manned seventeen castles along the hundred leagues of the Wall
distances.cite: ACOK, Jon (the Wall's length; the two end castles stand at its ends, so a lower bound)
